title: Machine Learning Approach for Candida albicans Fluconazole Resistance Detection Using Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry.
summary: MALDI-TOF spectra from 33 C. albicans isolates from 15 patients were analyzed using 32 ML algorithms across six preparation conditions; an LDA pipeline reached 85.71% accuracy, 83.33% sensitivity and 88.89% specificity. Evidence is limited to the stated retrospective/in-silico/prototype setting. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
